name: Reino dos mortos
text: uma vez por turno caso esse tile seja atacado e não tenha criaturas nele volte uma critura de seu cemiterio até o final do turno para a defender
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Individual painted terrain illustration for medieval dark nautical TCG Roubo de tumbas. Subject: Reino dos mortos: monumental kingdom of the dead, ancient coastal necropolis with sprawling mausoleums and open sepulchral gates, ghostly pale light awakening inside tombs suggesting temporary defenders, no characters. Detailed hand-painted oil fantasy landscape, layered depth, moon violet charcoal and bone palette, weathered stone and sea fog. 4:3 landscape; focal architecture central and crop-safe. No frame, letters, words, mana symbols, card UI or watermark. One artwork only, no atlas.
